- **AI won’t make our content smart if we stay static. I really enjoyed the panel discussion we just had at NEXT CX & AI Vienna about how we move from more content to better content. My takeaways from the meeting: ✅ 95% of GenAI projects fail—because we chase tools instead of fixing the basics. ✅ Scale starts at brainstorming, not after the pilot. ✅ Tag everything for real-time insights. ✅ HCPs are humans first, not just “customers.” ✅ We’re now creating content for humans AND machines (think GenAI engines). That means adjusting how we design, tag, and measure. We don’t need more funnels. We need customer excellence, not vanity metrics. Big thanks to Haider ALLEG and the panel Lorena Cabré, MBA Mubasher Hassan Chris Kubby for the honest conversation. P.S. If our AI strategy starts with “let’s make more content,” maybe we should step away from the keyboard. #NextPharmaSummit #CX #AI #PharmaContent #CustomerExcellence ...more**

- **Last week, I had the honour of facilitating an interactive fireside chat with two members of UCB ‘s Global Executive Committee — Fiona du Monceau - de Hemptinne , Global Head of Patient Impact and Denelle Waynick Johnson , Global Head of Ethics & Legal Affairs, during their visit to our Canadian affiliate. This opportunity traces back to a decision I made a couple of years ago to step outside my comfort zone and take on the role of WiL (Women in Leadership) Canada Lead. From there, I’ve established the official Canadian chapter and began the initiative of facilitating fireside chats (alongside my amazing team) featuring UCB Canada ’s leaders sharing their career journeys, so their perspectives and learnings could be absorbed across the affiliate. None of this was part of my actual job description. But it's opened doors and growth opportunities I never expected, including the chance to sit down with two global leaders and dig into what shaped their careers. A few things they shared that stuck with me: ✨ “It - will - be uncomfortable trying something new, but that’s how you can be sure you’re growing." ✨”Be confident in yourself and your goals & directly ask for what you want." A huge thank you to our Canadian leadership team for trusting me with this opportunity. It's a reminder that raising your hand for something outside your lane can open doors you didn't even know existed. I’ll be holding on to and reflecting on this special moment for the rest of the year! #WomenInLeadership #CareerGrowth #Leadership #Mentorship #TeamUCB**
